coverage: PhysX angular state and solver iterations

findings.finding: Independent angular-velocity initialization and solver iteration settings allow constant-spin and torque experiments to separate readout disagreement from integrated orientation error.
findings.relevance: Open yaw-refinement finding in the installed GPU runtime
findings.direction_alignment: Continue simulation development after the evaluation explorer merge by investigating the remaining numerical discrepancy.
findings.opportunity_or_risk: Current public integration source does not establish which GPU kernel the pinned binary executes; matched read channels narrow the investigation but do not prove a vendor root cause.
findings.engineering_cost: One bounded 30-case diagnostic matrix and strict offline verifier
findings.roadmap_delta: AL-013 isolates yaw sampling and iteration sensitivity; original AL-010 criteria remain unchanged
findings.verification_needed: Clean-source GPU traces at three timesteps and two iteration counts, dual read channels, analytic references, corruption tests and measured plots

overall_recommendation: Measure signed yaw and read-channel consistency before considering a solver or controller change.
evidence_gaps: Installed GPU kernel behavior has not been independently localized
No aircraft calibration or estimator model
